text.text_excerpt: I adore Terranova's! They have a little of everything. Small family-run grocery store that puts customer service at the top of its list. But what I truly love about Terranova's is their sausage! I love almost every kind of sausage imaginable and all of their sausage is made from scratch by the owner and his son. Best sausage in town!! If you come early enough on a Saturday morning they also sell a few muffulettas. Only on Saturdays though. Great neighborhood feel. Incredibly friendly people. Wonderful grocery! If you come once you will come again and again.

As an Italian Texan, I always seek out old school Italian grocery stores with homemade sausage and other rarities. This is what lead me to Terranova's. Good homemade Italian sausage (I would like if they added more finocchio and crushed red pepper) but still a flavorful sausage. Strong ups for their Hog's Head Cheese. A real pleasant surprise. Haven't tried the other varieties of sausages, since I only have so much room in my cooler for the haul back to TX, but I'll be back soon. Cool old store, real close to Cafe Degas, another foodie stop you need to consider.

Even if I didn't live within walking distance to this classic little family-run corner grocery store. I would be happy to travel to get the fresh-in-house-made Italian Sausage, honestly the best I have ever tasted in my life. I recently tried the Hog's Head Cheese (also made in-house) and it does not disappoint, perfectly seasoned and meaty. I love to support the local merchants and in this case, it is because they are better than the big-boys. Added bonus: I noticed that they have beers priced better than "the place across the street".
